h:
易于使用的 Ideogram 4 工作流程，带有 KJ Prompt 生成器。它还包括块前馈和闪存注意节点。您可以在工作流程和步骤中设置调度程序和采样器。已经为您的第一代设置了设置，然后从那里开始。

如果您安装了 FA，则默认情况下会绕过 Flash 注意节点，您只需启用它们并运行即可。

o.en:
An easy to use Ideogram 4 workflow with KJ Prompt builder. It also includes chunk feed forward and flash attention nodes. You're able to set scheduler and sampler in the workflow and steps. Settings already set for your first gen then go from there.

Flash attention nodes are bypassed by default if you have FA installed you can just enable them and run.
